decisions.text: type waterfall: the parts mix positive and negative values and running subtotals are the message: a waterfall, each bar starting where the last ended (G1.38)
values on both sides of zero: room at both ends
the steps in the process's own order, as given; a waterfall is never sorted (D-43)

each step a bar from the running total before it to the one after it: rises Sales, Loan, falls Fit-out, Ovens, Wages, Rent, green where it rises and red where it falls, higher being good (R15-11, G4.16); Start, End full bars from zero in the reserved grey (G4.15), each equal to the running total there (G7.33)
8 values against 5 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
value labels as a set, one magnitude and one number of decimals, the prefix and suffix on each: $40K, −$95K, −$30K, +$150K, −$60K, −$25K, +$60K, $40K (G6.16, G7.4)

each value just past its bar's far end, the steps signed and the totals not: $40K, −$95K, −$30K, +$150K, −$60K, −$25K, +$60K, $40K; past the near end for Wages, the far one putting it across the zero line or another bar (G7.4, G6.16)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “cash in and out”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude
a hairline connector at each running total, from one bar to the next (s. 0237)

static output, in colour: one file, red for bad and green for good, plain, for every reader (D-18; owner, 1 Oct 2026); black and white (audience.bw_risk) adds the textures, and a style may choose the colour-blind-safe pair (--good-bad-mode: safe-pair)
